lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song to the LORD because He has done wonders.
His right hand and holy arm gained Him the victory, and He revealed His righteousness to the nations of Egypt.
He remembered His love and faithfulness to Israel, and all the earth is called to make a joyful noise.
Praise comes with the lyre and the harp, then with cymbals and the ram's horn before the LORD, the King.
The sea, the rivers and the mountains rejoice before the LORD, for He comes to judge the world with righteousness and equity.
